sentences.text: Counsel for the applicant submitted that the applicant has been falsely implicated in the instant case.
False recovery of 25 kg (25 packets) Ganja has been shown from a car, which does not belong to the applicant.
The car was driven by the co-accused, Parmeshwar Sahu.
There is nothing on record to demonstrate 'conscious possession' of the applicant.
False recovery of a country made pistol and two live cartridges has also been shown from the personal possession of the applicant.
There are no independent witnesses to the recovery.
Recovery of a mobile phone has also been shown from the applicant.
The said mobile phone belongs to the applicant.
The mandatory provisions of Sections 42, 50, 51 and 52A of N.D.P.S. Act have not been complied with.
Sample was taken from a single packet.

The procedure of sampling prescribed in Rule 8, 9, 10 (1), 12 and 13 of the Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances (Seizure, Storage, Sampling and Disposal) Rules,
2022 have been violated.

2022
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: It is next contended that identically placed co-accused, Sushil Patel has been granted bail by this Court vide order dated 12.12.2023 passed in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 53289 of 2023.

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 53289 of 2023
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: The applicant claims parity.
The applicant is in jail since 21.08.2023, having no criminal history and in case he is enlarged on bail, he will not misuse the said liberty.
5. Learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail but could not satisfactorily dispute the aforesaid submissions from the record.
6. Having heard counsel for the parties and having perused the record this Court prima facie finds that the mandate of Sections 42, 50, 51 and 52A of the N.D.P.S. Act has not been followed.
There is no independent witness to the alleged recovery.
Sample was not taken from each packet.
Sample was taken from one packet and was sent to the Forensic Science Laboratory.
The inventory of the seized contraband was also not certified by the Magistrate.

Thus, the procedure of sampling adopted is in violation of Rules 8, 9, 10 and 11 of the Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances (Seizure,
Storage, Sampling and Disposal) Rules, 2022.

entities.text:

Storage, Sampling and Disposal) Rules, 2022
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Further, identically placed co-accused, Sushil Patel has been granted bail by this Court.
The applicant has no criminal antecedents.
Hence, there are reasonable grounds to believe that the applicant shall not indulge himself in other cases of like nature.

Moreover, the applicant has remained confined for more than three months and there is no hope of early conclusion of trial, more so when no reasonable apprehension has been brought to the fore by the State that the applicant, if enlarged on bail, would either tamper with the evidence or delay the trial or intimidate the witness, without commenting on merits of the case, I am of the opinion that the applicant is entitled to be enlarged on bail.
